{{Top}}
'''Red Ten''' was the callsign of the tenth member of [[Red Squadron]]. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] with this designation, and several beings went by the callsign.

==History==
The callsign was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Theron Nett/Legends|Theron Nett]] when he flew during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[R2-X2/Legends|R2-X2]] was Red Ten's on-board astromech droid unit during the battle.<ref name="CCG R2-X2">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=R2-X2}}</ref> Nett and his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] were killed in the assault against the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. He was shot down by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] after [[Puck Naeco/Legends|Puck Naeco's]] death in the [[Meridian trench/Legends|meridian trench]] while covering [[Garven Dreis]] during their attack run.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

The pilot known as [[Beau]] flew as Red Ten in the Red Squadron assigned to the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']] in the months leading up to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="XWA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>
